technology_name: Retort Pouch Packed Thermally Processed Tender Jackfruit
problem_solved: Short shelf life of tender jackfruit and post-harvest losses
description: Technology for preserving tender jackfruit through thermal processing and retort pouch packaging. The process is intended to improve storage stability and product usability while maintaining suitability for food applications.

Jackfruit processing and value-addition industries
Ready-to-eat and convenience food manufacturers
Food service, catering, and institutional kitchen providers
Export-oriented processed food enterprises
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agro-processing startups developing jackfruit-based products
